commands: forge verify --repo /home/sam/projects/fairdm/fairdm-worktrees/011-restful-api --base origin/main (conformance, docs, lint, typecheck, test, build all passed)

deviations.what: T035's implementation of the options/tags default sits in the T027 commit (Component.default_exclude in fairdm/registry/config.py), and the relation-filter tests are in a second T028 commit, so T035 holds the filter, router and check changes.
deviations.why: Each task's tests and the code that makes them pass were committed together where a test failed for the right reason before the change.

deviations.what: The API's copy of a type's filter set removes a filter on a relation with no uuid when the filter set is built for a request, not on the class.
deviations.why: The sample filter mixin reads polymorphic_ctype while it is built, so removing it from the class breaks the mixin. The generated schema therefore still lists that filter, which a request ignores.

deviations.what: Tests T028 and T034 register a viewset on the router by reloading fairdm.api.urls and fairdm.conf.urls (new fixture on_the_router in tests/test_api/conftest.py).
deviations.why: The router's addresses are read once when fairdm.api.urls first loads, so a registration made during a test is served only after the modules load again. The fixture undoes both at the end.

concerns: The first full verify run failed on three type-annotation errors in fairdm/api/filters.py and fairdm/api/checks.py. They were fixed in 30f7d9c5 and verify was run again with every step passing.
CHANGELOG.md has no entry for FS-011 on this branch; none was added in this story.

The generated OpenAPI schema still lists the content-type (polymorphic_ctype) filter on sample and measurement lists, although a request ignores it (fairdm/api/filters.py, fairdm/core/sample/filters.py:140 reads it while the filter set is built).

The router reads its addresses once, when fairdm.api.urls is first imported, so a viewset registered after that is served only when the module is loaded again. The module docstring and docs/portal-development/restful-api.md now say where to register.
feature-state.json and the tasks.md checkboxes for T027 to T036 were not changed in this story.
The check fairdm.E600 is tagged models, not production-critical, so a registration mistake stops runserver, migrate and manage.py check but not a production boot that skips those commands.
